text:
Tara Simmons: Heads up — Acme MedTech kickoff with their engineering + compliance team tomorrow at 10am. They want a 4‑week POC for clinical note summarization + a convergent QA assistant. PHI scope is the big blocker.
Mike Chen: Understood. Main open items: deployment mode (VPC vs on‑prem), model context length, embeddings + reranker approach, and pricing for a reserved Dedicated slot if they need sustained throughput. :thinking_face:
Anya Patel: Success criteria we promised: 1) 95% coverage of key findings in summaries (measured on 200 notes), 2) median response latency <700ms for 512 token outputs under our avg load, 3) no PHI exfiltration (audit logs + KMS). Confirmed? 
Kevin Liu: For model, recommend a 32k context open model quantized to int8 on Dedicated for the long discharge notes. For strict PHI, Private (VPC with audit logs + customer KMS) is simplest from compliance side.
Paul Ortega: Security checklist: must support customer-managed KMS, VPC peering, detailed audit logs, and an ICS export for their DLP team. Can we include an acceptable-data-flow diagram in the response pack? :white_check_mark:
Lisa Monroe: Client asked about fallback behavior — if Dedicated is saturated, they'd want auto‑fallback to a smaller hosted model with reduced context. Pricing question: how to price that mixed mode during POC? They prefer a predictable commit for the trial.
Mike Chen: Proposed POC config: 1 Dedicated pool (p3dx2 equivalent) pinned to 32k model variant, autoscale off, burst to hosted when idle. Pricing: pro‑rated reserved for 4 weeks + metered overage for hosted fallback. I'll draft numbers.
Tara Simmons: Also they asked about reranker vs hybrid reranker. Use dense embeddings for retrieval, then a cheap cross‑encoder reranker on top for top‑10. That keeps token costs down.
Kevin Liu: Agree. Evaluation plan: build an eval set of 250 clinical QA pairs (client-supplied) + 100 edge long notes. Run: retrieval (FAISS dense) -> embed model: small embedder (384d) -> retriever -> cross-encoder rerank. Monitor precision@5 and chrF for summaries.
Anya Patel: Can we include an automated prompt-regression harness? If we roll a quantized model we should run prompt sets and compare on rouge/chrF and a simple hallucination rate check.
Mike Chen: Example eval harness snippet:
```
# pseudo
load_eval_set('acme_med_notes.json')
for prompt in prompts:
  out = call_model(model_variant, prompt, max_tokens=512)
  score = rouge(out, gold)
  log(result_id, model_variant, score)
```
Kevin Liu: We'll also push KV-prefix caching for repeated patient context to reduce token costs.
Paul Ortega: On legal: client will only sign if we provide SOC2 + ISO listing and can attest no PHI leaves their VPC. Need the standard paperwork — I'll attach it to the deck.
Lisa Monroe: Client wants SLA target for latency during demo week. Can we guarantee 99.9% for median p50 latency and 99% for p95? That's their ask.
Mike Chen: For Dedicated we can commit to p50 < 500ms and p95 < 1.2s with the config above — I'll add the SLA numbers and failure/fallback policy.
Tara Simmons: Action items before kickoff: Mike — pricing + config doc; Kevin — eval harness + model matrix (32k vs 16k vs hosted smaller); Paul — compliance pack; Anya — success criteria + acceptance tests. Can everyone ack?
Mike Chen: Ack — I'll have pricing doc in 3 hours and slide for tomorrow.
Kevin Liu: Ack — model matrix + eval plan by EOD.
Paul Ortega: Ack — compiling compliance pack now.
Anya Patel: Ack — acceptance tests drafted, will share sample prompts.
Lisa Monroe: I'll run the client logistics and include a short demo script. :thumbsup:
DeployBot: Deployed branch "sales/acme_med_poc" to staging (sha: a1b2c3) :rocket:
Tara Simmons: Great. One more thought — tool calling: they want connectors to their MedDB API for structured queries. We should scope tool security review as well.
Mike Chen: For tool calling we'll use Redwood's tool sandboxing + per-call ACLs. Add tool review to Paul's checklist.
Paul Ortega: Added. Also adding quantization regression to security review: confirm no unexpected outputs from int8 path.
Tara Simmons: Perfect. I'll prep the slide deck and send to client after we attach the compliance pack and pricing. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
